title: "The Bond Films"
jupyter: python3
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```



```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide revenue of the Bond films over time (USD)"

bond_sorted = bond.sort_values("year")
plt.plot(bond_sorted["year"], bond_sorted["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (USD in millions)")
plt.show()
```
